behaviors_covered.rf.matched_t_attenuator: All three nondefault outputs; terminated nodal input match and power conservation; tiny positive attenuation with independent hyperbolic asymptotes; impedance scaling and 400 dB attenuation; all scalar/nonfinite errors and complete recovery.
behaviors_covered.rf.lowpass_l_match: All three nondefault outputs; independent complex load-admittance match; frequency scaling, representably adjacent resistances, equal/reversed rejection; finite-output ratio, frequency and denominator overflow regressions; all scalar/nonfinite errors and complete recovery.
behaviors_covered.rf.free_space_link_budget: All three nondefault outputs via linear power density and effective receiving area; inverse-square distance, both antenna gains, zero loss, negative directional gain and signed/zero margin; both far-field branches at equality and one ulp below; all scalar/nonfinite errors and complete recovery.
behaviors_covered.rf.first_fresnel_clearance: All three nondefault outputs via half-wavelength paraxial excess; TX/RX exchange, midpoint maximum, quadrupled carrier frequency, signed/zero obstruction, exact zero margin, closed fraction endpoints, both endpoint screens, overflow-resistant large geometry; all scalar/nonfinite errors and complete recovery.
behaviors_covered.rf.circular_aperture_gain: All three nondefault outputs via collecting area and reciprocity; diameter/frequency square laws; half, unit and tiny positive efficiency; strict two-wavelength boundary and next-f64 acceptance; finite-output D*f overflow regression; all scalar/nonfinite errors and complete recovery.
behaviors_covered.rf.two_tone_im3: All seven nondefault outputs with negative gain/IIP3; independent linear-power sum and cubic spur ratio; 1:3 slopes, intercept shift, very low input power, exact summed-output limit, one-ulp-below rejection, equal/reversed/octave tones and Pin>=IIP3 rejection, tiny positive lower mixing frequency; all scalar/nonfinite errors and complete recovery.
behaviors_covered.rf.monostatic_radar_return: Both nondefault outputs from two separate spherical spreading stages and receive aperture; inverse-fourth range, twice antenna-gain effect, RCS scaling/tiny RCS, once-only total loss, signed/zero margin; both larger-dimension choices and ten-wavelength screen at equality/below; all scalar/nonfinite errors and complete recovery.
behaviors_covered.shared: Nonfinite injection at all 36 input positions, positive-domain zero/negative rejection, bounded efficiencies/fractions and nonnegative losses; each scalar rejection immediately followed by fully checked nondefault output map. Shared common helper only.

oracle_provenance.method: Independent algebra and Python scalar arithmetic, never catalog example outputs or expression evaluation. Research/feature/backlog sources were read; primary-source retrieval is inherited, not freshly claimed.
oracle_provenance.tolerance_policy: Rust nonzero numerical outputs generally 1e-12 relative, no absolute floor. Subnormal L-match C regressions use 1e-10 relative for quantization. Parent maps generally 1e-11, regressions 1e-10. Absolute 1e-12 applies only to zero dB margins from independent logarithm order and zero impedance imaginary part from cancellation of 40-ohm reactances.

verification: NOT EXECUTED. No builds, tests, lint, formatters, backend/process evaluation, smoke checks or native launches. Only source reading, independent oracle arithmetic and test/receipt authoring. Main must execute all 25 authored Rust tests and all 45 ordered JSON-lines scenarios; four finite-output regressions intentionally expect success despite statically identified snapshot defects.
untested_gaps: All authored Rust tests and parent process scenarios await Main execution; compilation is not claimed.
Native UI, all RF diagram pixels, packaged desktop and accessibility acceptance remain reviewer/Main scope.
Hardware parasitics, measured aperture efficiency/RCS, propagation/multipath, and characterized amplifier linearity limits are not experimentally validated.
Binary64 extremes beyond the explicit regressions and platform-specific math-library behavior are not exhaustively covered.
